energy.summary: Anchored by an active VPP rollout with Every Electric, the clean energy leader's exhibit highlights a signature home backup solution, pairing its flagship Explorer 5000 Plus with the Jackery Automatic ...

ai.summary: Jackery, a portable power station maker, will show its home backup and virtual power plant products at the RE+ 2026 clean energy event in Las Vegas. Its virtual power plant (VPP, a network of home batteries that work together to ease grid demand) is already running with Every Electric, and it is linked to a New York City program that has reportedly saved residents money. The company is also presenting its Automatic Transfer Switch (a device that moves a home to battery power during an outage) and the Explorer 5000 Plus, a large battery unit, along with a Red Cross edition series.
points: Every Electric is partnering with Jackery on a VPP using thousands of portable power stations plugged into standard household outlets
The NYC A/C Powerbank Program involves roughly 2,000 power stations across over 1,000 households, with a waitlist of over 15,000 people
The Jackery ATS switches to backup power in 20ms or less, and the Explorer 5000 Plus offers 7,200W of continuous AC output
ai.why: For a business owner, backup power and off-peak electricity planning could matter for keeping office or shop operations running during outages and managing electricity costs.
